fields.description: Unique short key for this agent/profile. Use lowercase words with hyphens, e.g. chirag-skin. LiveKit route metadata uses this key to fetch the correct prompt.
fields.label: Profile Key

fields.description: Human name/persona used by the voice agent during calls, e.g. Chirag, Kamal, Siya Ayurveda Assistant.
fields.label: Agent Name

fields.description: Internal note for your team. Example: Skin clinic inbound agent for +9179...
fields.label: Description

fields.description: Main behavior/instructions for this agent. Put clinic details, tone, allowed topics, appointment rules, and what the agent should/should not say.
fields.label: System Prompt

fields.default: The call has just connected. Immediately greet the customer warmly in Hindi and introduce yourself and SRIAAS.
fields.description: First thing the agent says when the call connects. Keep it short and natural.
fields.label: Opening Greeting Instruction

fields.description: Gemini Live model used by the Render worker. Keep default unless you intentionally changed the worker/model support.
fields.label: Gemini Live Model

fields.description: Voice name for Gemini Live. Choose a supported Gemini voice configured in your worker.
fields.label: Gemini Live Voice

fields.description: Google Vertex AI region. Must match where Gemini Live is available for your Google project. Current setup uses us-central1.
fields.label: Vertex Location

fields.description: Google Cloud project ID that owns Vertex AI/Gemini credentials, e.g. newapp-496411.
fields.label: Google Cloud Project

fields.description: Optional tool/MCP server URL if the voice agent should call external tools. Leave blank if tools are handled directly by Frappe/worker.
fields.label: MCP Server URL

fields.description: Optional token for MCP server. Store secret value here only if your MCP server requires bearer auth.
fields.label: MCP Bearer Token

fields.description: Tool name the worker should call when creating/updating a lead. Keep default unless your worker uses a different tool name.
fields.label: Lead Creation Tool Name

fields.description: Rules to prevent medical diagnosis, prescriptions, guarantees, or unsafe claims. This is appended to the agent prompt.
fields.label: Medical Guardrail Policy

fields.description: When the agent must escalate to human/emergency care, e.g. severe symptoms, emergency language, urgent callback.
fields.label: Escalation Policy

fields.description: Comma-separated actions the voice agent may perform. Example: create_lead,send_whatsapp. The worker must also implement the action.
fields.label: Allowed Voice Actions

fields.description: Phone number that should open this voice-agent profile. Use full number with country code, e.g. +917971442066.
fields.label: DID / Phone Number

fields.description: Auto-filled from DID / Phone Number after save. Used internally for matching.
fields.label: Normalized DID

fields.description: Optional link to Vobiz Account Mapping for defaults like owner, source, pipeline, and department.
fields.label: Vobiz Account Mapping

fields.description: LiveKit SIP inbound trunk ID for this number. Find it in LiveKit Cloud -> Telephony/SIP -> Inbound Trunks. Example: ST_xxxxx.
fields.label: LiveKit Inbound Trunk ID

fields.description: Vobiz/provider trunk ID from webhook payload or provider setup. Use this for mapping/reporting; LiveKit dispatch uses the LiveKit inbound trunk above.
fields.label: Vobiz Trunk ID

fields.description: Optional SIP/domain value from Vobiz/provider payload. Leave blank if not needed.
fields.label: Domain

fields.description: When enabled, saving/deploying this profile creates or updates the matching Vobiz Voice Agent Route and LiveKit SIP dispatch rule.
fields.label: Auto Sync to LiveKit on Save

fields.description: Name of the single Render/LiveKit worker that answers calls. For your setup keep this as vobiz-gemini-live.
fields.label: LiveKit Agent Dispatch Name

fields.description: Prefix for LiveKit rooms created by dispatch rule. Example: vobiz- creates rooms like vobiz-xxxxx.
fields.label: Room Prefix

fields.description: Auto-filled after LiveKit sync. This is the SIP dispatch rule ID created/updated in LiveKit.
fields.label: LiveKit Dispatch Rule ID
